        # Nodes on root shortest paths are useful relay candidates because they

        relay_score = {}
        relay_routes = {}
        for dst, path in root_paths.items():

                    from_relay = nx.dijkstra_path(h, relay, dst, weight="cost")

                saving = root_cost[dst] - via

        relays = sorted(
            relay_score,
            key=lambda node: (-relay_score[node], str(node)),

        def cluster_tree(root, members):
            """Solve one directed Steiner cluster with subset dynamic programming."""
            if not members:
                return set()
            members = list(dict.fromkeys(members))[:10]
            nodes = list(h.nodes)
            position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(nodes)}
            count = len(members)
            full = (1 << count) - 1
            inf = float("inf")
            dp = [[inf] * len(nodes) for _ in range(1 << count)]
            choice = [[None] * len(nodes) for _ in range(1 << count)]

            for bit, dst in enumerate(members):
                dp[1 << bit][position[dst]] = 0.0

            reverse = [[] for _ in nodes]
            for u, v, data in h.edges(data=True):
                reverse[position[v]].append(
                    (position[u], float(data["cost"]), v)
                )

            for mask in range(1, full + 1):
                sub = (mask - 1) & mask
                while sub:
                    other = mask ^ sub
                    if sub < other:
                        for i in range(len(nodes)):
                            value = dp[sub][i] + dp[other][i]
                            if value < dp[mask][i]:
                                dp[mask][i] = value
                                choice[mask][i] = ("merge", sub)
                    sub = (sub - 1) & mask

                heap = [
                    (dp[mask][i], i)
                    for i in range(len(nodes))
                    if dp[mask][i] < inf
                ]
                heapq.heapify(heap)
                while heap:
                    value, vi = heapq.heappop(heap)
                    if value != dp[mask][vi]:
                        continue
                    for ui, cost, successor in reverse[vi]:
                        candidate = value + cost
                        if candidate < dp[mask][ui]:
                            dp[mask][ui] = candidate
                            choice[mask][ui] = ("edge", successor)
                            heapq.heappush(heap, (candidate, ui))

            if root not in position or dp[full][position[root]] == inf:
                return None

            edges = set()

            def recover(mask, node):
                item = choice[mask][position[node]]
                if item is None:
                    return
                if item[0] == "merge":
                    recover(item[1], node)
                    recover(mask ^ item[1], node)
                else:
                    successor = item[1]
                    edges.add((node, successor))
                    recover(mask, successor)

            recover(full, root)
            return edges

        def relay_candidate(relay):

            try:
